objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, or work instructions that undergo creation, editing, versioning, and release cycles.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category of document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document such as Editing, Released, or Out of Force

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the document

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date after which the document is no longer valid

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code prefix for the document type

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Name or title of the document

objs.name: author
objs.description: User responsible for creating and initially signing a document.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user for document creation

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: User responsible for checking document content according to technical and formal aspects.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user for document review

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: User responsible for approving and publishing a document.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user for document release

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document or file attached to a main document that is released with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of the attachment such as Released or Archived

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Informational document or file attached to a main document that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Publication state of the additional information

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A suggested modification to an existing document that does not affect the document's version history until implemented.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State such as Pending, Planned, or Completed

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to review and confirm extended validity of a document before expiration.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State such as Pending or Approved

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that has no additional validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State such as Pending or Approved

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State such as Pending or Approved

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned to a document for distribution or authorization purposes.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category such as Reader, Author, or Archive

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of users or user groups to be notified of or required to acknowledge document release.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category such as Email Distribution or Acknowledgement Distribution

objs.name: translator
objs.description: User responsible for translating released document content into another language.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user for translation

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined document structure used as a basis for creating new documents.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: File format such as Word, Excel, or PowerPoint

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Document type the template is associated with

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: An automated process for managing document approvals through defined steps and participants.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state such as In Progress or Completed

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Current stage in the workflow process

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach a new document object to the system with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modify document content or properties including metadata and attributes.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Designate a user as the author of a document with associated permissions.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Designate a user as the reviewer of a document for a release workflow.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Designate a user as the releaser of a document for final approval.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronically sign a document by an authorized user during workflow steps.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check document content for technical and formal correctness as a reviewer.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Publish and distribute a document after approval by releaser.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled document or file to a main document.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Add informational content to a document without subjecting it to release cycle control.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Propose modifications to a document without affecting its current version.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Integrate an approved change proposal into a new version of a document.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Generate a new version of a document following content or property changes.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Mark a released document as archived, revoking user authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Generate a system request to review and confirm continued validity of a document.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm and update the validity period of a document by authorized releasers or release team.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiate a request to invalidate a document with no additional validity.

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: Confirm invalidation of a document and transition it to out-of-force status.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiate a request to re-validate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restore a previously invalidated document to active status with new version.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign user groups or persons to receive notifications or acknowledgement requests for document releases.

evts.name: send_distribution_email
evts.description: Notify assigned users of a document release via email.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request assigned users to actively confirm receipt and understanding of a document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Accept and confirm receipt of a document by an assigned user.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-dependent version of a released document.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check translated document content for accuracy and completeness.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve and publish a translated version of a document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment as archived when a new version of the main document is released.
